task_list: Replace or supplement session-only throttling with server-side rate limiting that cannot be reset by creating a new session, such as a bounded rate-limit bucket keyed by client IP address plus action, with sensible expiry and cleanup.

Apply the non-bypassable rate limiter to recovery-token issuance, reset-token verification, password-change attempts, and MFA verification attempts; retain the existing per-session limits as defense in depth if desired.
Send an explicit acceptance value from the privacy form, for example { accepted: check.checked }, to /api/recovery/privacy-accept.
Require body.accepted === true in /api/recovery/privacy-accept; otherwise return a validation error and do not set privacyAccepted or advance the recovery stage.
